findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "where_is" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "post_club_ride" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Post a DRAFT group ride (Windline) or club run (RunFast) on a club or organiser page the signed-in person runs, from a GPX route or link, once or weekly: always…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plan_route, create_event, invite_members · Private data: club_in_race, event_weather, fly_route, tour_route, find_coaches, plan_route, list_my_events, create_event, publish_event, post_club_ride · Public sink: where_is, find_clubs, find_coaches, publish_event, post_club_ride, invite_members · Destructive: find_person, where_is, club_in_race, plan_route, list_my_events, create_event, post_club_ride.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: plan_route, create_event, invite_members · Private data: club_in_race, event_weather, fly_route, tour_route, find_coaches, plan_route, list_my_events, create_event, publish_event, post_club_ride · Public sink: where_is, find_clubs, find_coaches, publish_event, post_club_ride, invite_members · Destructive: find_person, where_is, club_in_race, plan_route, list_my_events, create_event, post_club_ride

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
